q: 18 अगस्त 2026 को घोषित राष्ट्रीय खेल पुरस्कार 2025 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा तथ्य सही है?
o: Two athletes received the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award.
Only Dronacharya Awards were announced in August 2026.
Twenty-five athletes received the Arjuna Award and one received Khel Ratna.
No Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award was conferred, while 17 athletes received the Arjuna Award.
e: In the National Sports Awards 2025 announced on 18 August 2026, no Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award was conferred, while 17 sportspersons received the Arjuna Award (कोई खेल रत्न नहीं दिया गया और 17 खिलाड़ियों को अर्जुन पुरस्कार मिला). Exam Boosters: (1) The awards are conferred by the President of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan on National Sports Day (29 August); (2) Arjuna Award was instituted in 1961; (3) Major Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement honours retired sportspersons; (4) Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy is awarded to the top-performing university in sports.
qe: Which of the following facts about the National Sports Awards 2025 (announced on 18 August 2026) is correct?
oe: Two athletes received the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award.
Only Dronacharya Awards were announced in August 2026.
Twenty-five athletes received the Arjuna Award and one received Khel Ratna.
No Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award was conferred, while 17 athletes received the Arjuna Award.

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में इसरो (ISRO) ने किस वर्ष तक भारत में चार सक्रिय अंतरिक्ष प्रक्षेपण स्थल (launch sites) संचालित करने का रणनीतिक लक्ष्य घोषित किया?
e: ISRO targets having four active launch sites operational by 2029 to expand commercial and national orbital launch capacity (इसरो का लक्ष्य वर्ष 2029 तक चार सक्रिय प्रक्षेपण स्थल संचालित करना है). Exam Boosters: (1) Sriharikota (SDSC-SHAR, Andhra Pradesh) currently hosts two active orbital launch pads (FLP & SLP) with a Third Launch Pad planned; (2) Kulasekarapattinam (Tamil Nadu) is being developed as India's second dedicated orbital spaceport; (3) NSIL (NewSpace India Limited) is ISRO's commercial arm; (4) India's first satellite Aryabhata was launched on 19 April 1975.
qe: In October 2026, ISRO announced its strategic target to have four active space launch sites operational across India by which year?

q:
'ग्रीन एनर्जी कॉरिडोर' (अक्टूबर 2026 में चरण III स्वीकृत) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: इसका उद्देश्य नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा को राष्ट्रीय ग्रिड में एकीकृत करने हेतु विद्युत पारेषण बुनियादी ढाँचे को सुदृढ़ करना है।
कथन II: इसे नवीन और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा मंत्रालय (MNRE) के अंतर्गत क्रियान्वित किया जाता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct: Phase III of the Green Energy Corridor (approved Oct 2026) expands transmission lines and substations for renewable energy evacuation under MNRE (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) PM-KUSUM scheme promotes solar pumps and decentralized solar power for farmers; (2) PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana promotes rooftop solar installations in 1 crore households; (3) India's 2030 target is 500 GW non-fossil fuel capacity; (4) International Solar Alliance (ISA) is headquartered in Gurugram.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Green Energy Corridor' (Phase III approved in October 2026):
Statement I: It is aimed at strengthening power transmission infrastructure for integrating renewable energy into the national grid.
Statement II: It is implemented under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: उद्योगों का वार्षिक सर्वेक्षण (ASI) 2024–25 रिपोर्ट (अक्टूबर 2026 में जारी), जिसमें भारत के विनिर्माण उत्पादन में 7.81% की वृद्धि दर्ज की गई, किस केंद्रीय एजेंसी द्वारा आयोजित किया जाता है?
o: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
e: The Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) is conducted by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) (ASI का आयोजन सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय के NSO द्वारा किया जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) ASI is the principal source of industrial statistics for India's organized manufacturing sector; (2) Wholesale Price Index (WPI) is released by the Office of the Economic Adviser (DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry); (3) CPI (Combined) is released by NSO (MoSPI); (4) National Statistics Day is celebrated on 29 June.
qe: The Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2024–25 report (released in October 2026), which reported 7.81% growth in India's manufacturing output, is conducted by which central agency?
oe: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

q: प्रथम अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मक्का सम्मेलन 2026 (नवंबर 2026) के दौरान मक्का की खेती के क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से विश्व में भारत का कौन-सा स्थान रेखांकित किया गया?
e: India ranks 4th globally in terms of area under maize cultivation (मक्का की खेती के क्षेत्रफल में भारत विश्व में चौथे स्थान पर है). Exam Boosters: (1) Maize (Zea mays) is grown in Kharif, Rabi, and Zaid seasons in India; (2) It is rich in starch and used for food, poultry feed, and ethanol production; (3) ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research) was founded on 16 July 1929 (headquartered in New Delhi); (4) National Food Security Mission (NFSM) covers rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals (including maize), and nutri-cereals.
qe: During the First International Maize Conference 2026 (November 2026), what was highlighted as India's global ranking in terms of area under maize cultivation?

q:
प्री-COP31 (अक्टूबर 2026) में भारत की जलवायु कूटनीति के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: भारत ने UNFCCC ढाँचे के अंतर्गत पेरिस समझौते के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई।
कथन II: पेरिस समझौता केवल विकसित देशों पर बाध्यकारी है और इसमें विकासशील देशों से NDC प्रस्तुत करने की अपेक्षा नहीं की जाती।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is incorrect because under the Paris Agreement (2015), ALL parties (both developed and developing countries) submit Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) in line with CBDR-RC (पेरिस समझौते में सभी देश अपने NDC प्रस्तुत करते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Kyoto Protocol (1997) imposed binding emission targets only on Annex-I (developed) countries, whereas Paris Agreement covers all parties; (2) Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment) was launched by India at COP26; (3) India's Net Zero target is 2070; (4) UNEP is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding India's climate diplomacy at Pre-COP31 (October 2026):
Statement I: India reaffirmed its commitment to the Paris Agreement under the UNFCCC framework.
Statement II: The Paris Agreement is legally binding on developed countries only and does not require developing countries to submit NDCs.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की प्रथम महिला मुख्यमंत्री (तथा किसी भी भारतीय राज्य की प्रथम महिला मुख्यमंत्री) कौन थीं?
e: Sucheta Kripalani served as the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh from 1963 to 1967, becoming India's first woman Chief Minister (सुचेता कृपलानी उत्तर प्रदेश व भारत की प्रथम महिला मुख्यमंत्री थीं). Exam Boosters: (1) Sarojini Naidu was the first woman Governor of UP (and India, 1947–49); (2) Govind Ballabh Pant was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh; (3) Choudhary Charan Singh and V. P. Singh also served as CM of UP before becoming Prime Ministers of India; (4) UP has a bicameral legislature: Vidhan Sabha (403 elected seats) and Vidhan Parishad (100 seats).
qe: Who was the first woman Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (and also the first woman Chief Minister of any Indian state)?

q: वस्त्र और चमड़ा उद्योगों के कारण उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर को ऐतिहासिक रूप से 'उत्तर भारत का मैनचेस्टर' कहा जाता है?
e: Kanpur (located on the banks of the Ganga) is famous as the 'Manchester of North India' and 'Leather City of the World' (कानपुर को उत्तर भारत का मैनचेस्टर कहा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Ahmedabad (Gujarat) is called the 'Manchester of India', and Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu) is the 'Manchester of South India'; (2) IIT Kanpur (established 1959) and National Sugar Institute are located in Kanpur; (3) Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) is also located in Kanpur; (4) Firozabad is known for Glassware and Aligarh for Locks.
qe: Which city in Uttar Pradesh is historically known as the 'Manchester of North India' due to its textile and leather industries?

q: फतेहपुर सीकरी (आगरा, उत्तर प्रदेश) में स्थित 'बुलंद दरवाजा' का निर्माण सम्राट अकबर ने किस क्षेत्र पर अपनी विजय की स्मृति में करवाया था?
e: Emperor Akbar built the 54-metre-high Buland Darwaza ('Gate of Magnificence') at Fatehpur Sikri to commemorate his 1572–73 Gujarat conquest (अकबर ने गुजरात विजय की स्मृति में बुलंद दरवाजा बनवाया था). Exam Boosters: (1) Fatehpur Sikri was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1986; (2) UP has 3 UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Taj Mahal (1983), Agra Fort (1983), and Fatehpur Sikri (1986); (3) Tomb of Sufi saint Salim Chishti is inside Fatehpur Sikri; (4) Akbar's tomb is located at Sikandra (Agra).
qe: Buland Darwaza at Fatehpur Sikri (near Agra, Uttar Pradesh) was built by Emperor Akbar to commemorate his victory over which region?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के बुंदेलखंड क्षेत्र में किस जिले में सीमित मात्रा में यूरेनियम के भंडार पाए जाते हैं?
e: Uranium deposits in Uttar Pradesh are found in Lalitpur district (उत्तर प्रदेश में यूरेनियम ललितपुर जिले में पाया जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Lalitpur is surrounded on three sides by Madhya Pradesh; (2) Sonbhadra and Mirzapur districts are rich in limestone, bauxite, coal (Singrauli), and dolomite; (3) Banda and Mirzapur have diamond occurrences; (4) Silica sand (glass sand) is abundant in Prayagraj (Shankargarh) and Chitrakoot.
qe: In which district of Uttar Pradesh are India's limited Uranium deposits found in the Bundelkhand region?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक्सप्रेस-वे राज्य के 12 जिलों से होकर मेरठ को प्रयागराज (लगभग 594 किमी) से जोड़ता है?
e: The Ganga Expressway (~594 km, 6-lane expandable to 8-lane) connects Meerut to Prayagraj passing through 12 districts (गंगा एक्सप्रेस-वे मेरठ से प्रयागराज को जोड़ता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Purvanchal Expressway (341 km) connects Lucknow (Chandsarai) to Ghazipur (Haidaria); (2) Bundelkhand Expressway (296 km) connects Chitrakoot to Etawah (Agra-Lucknow Expressway); (3) Yamuna Expressway (165 km) connects Greater Noida to Agra; (4) Uttar Pradesh is often termed the 'Expressway Pradesh' of India.
qe: Which of the following expressways of Uttar Pradesh connects Meerut to Prayagraj (approximately 594 km) across 12 districts of the state?

q: गौतम बुद्ध ने अपना प्रथम उपदेश, जिसे बौद्ध परंपरा में 'धर्मचक्रप्रवर्तन' कहा जाता है, किस स्थान पर दिया था?
e: Gautam Buddha delivered his first sermon to five ascetics at the Deer Park (Rishipatana) in Sarnath, near Varanasi (बुद्ध ने प्रथम उपदेश सारनाथ में दिया था). Exam Boosters: (1) Birth: Lumbini (563 BCE); Enlightenment (Nirvana): Bodh Gaya under Bodhi Tree; Mahaparinirvana (Death): Kushinagar (UP); (2) Buddha delivered the maximum number of sermons at Shravasti (capital of Kosala, UP); (3) Four Buddhist Councils: Rajagriha (483 BCE), Vaishali (383 BCE), Pataliputra (250 BCE, Ashoka), Kashmir/Kundalvana (Kanishka); (4) Tripitakas (Vinaya, Sutta, Abhidhamma) were written in Pali.
qe: Where did Gautam Buddha deliver his first sermon, known in Buddhist tradition as 'Dhammachakkappavattana' (Turning of the Wheel of Law)?

q: सेल्यूकस निकेटर द्वारा चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य के दरबार में भेजा गया यूनानी राजदूत और ऐतिहासिक ग्रंथ 'इंडिका' का लेखक कौन था?
e: Megasthenes stayed at Pataliputra in Chandragupta Maurya's court and wrote 'Indica', describing Mauryan municipal administration and society (मेगस्थनीज चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य के दरबार में आया था और उसने 'इंडिका' लिखी). Exam Boosters: (1) Kautilya (Chanakya/Vishnugupta) wrote 'Arthashastra' (15 Adhikaranas on statecraft and economy); (2) Visakhadatta's Sanskrit play 'Mudrarakshasa' narrates Chandragupta's rise to power; (3) Deimachus visited Bindusara's court; (4) Ashoka's inscriptions were first deciphered by James Prinsep in 1837.
qe: Who was the Greek ambassador sent by Seleucus Nicator to the court of Chandragupta Maurya, and author of the historical account 'Indica'?

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत का कौन-सा सुल्तान कठोर बाजार नियंत्रण नीति (मूल्य निर्धारण) तथा 'दाग' (घोड़े दागना) और 'चेहरा/हुलिया' सैन्य सुधारों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Alauddin Khalji (reigned 1296–1316) established strict market regulations (Diwan-i-Riyasat, Shahna-i-Mandi) and introduced Dagh and Chehra to maintain a large standing army paid in cash (अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने बाजार नियंत्रण तथा दाग-चेहरा प्रथा चलाई). Exam Boosters: (1) Iltutmish introduced silver Tanka and copper Jital, and completed Qutub Minar; (2) Balban introduced Sijda and Paibos and 'Blood and Iron' policy; (3) Muhammad bin Tughlaq shifted capital from Delhi to Daulatabad and introduced token currency; (4) Amir Khusrau served in Alauddin Khalji's court.
qe: Which Delhi Sultan is famous for introducing strict market control regulations (price fixation) and the 'Dagh' (branding of horses) and 'Chehra' (descriptive roll of soldiers) military reforms?

q: 1905 में बंगाल विभाजन की घोषणा और कार्यान्वयन (जिससे स्वदेशी आंदोलन प्रारंभ हुआ) के समय भारत का वायसराय कौन था?
e: Lord Curzon implemented the Partition of Bengal on 16 October 1905, which triggered the Swadeshi and Boycott Movement (लॉर्ड कर्जन के समय 1905 में बंगाल विभाजन हुआ). Exam Boosters: (1) Partition of Bengal was annulled in December 1911 at the Delhi Durbar during Lord Hardinge II's tenure, when the capital was also shifted from Calcutta to Delhi; (2) Rabindranath Tagore composed 'Amar Shonar Bangla' during the anti-partition protests; (3) Surat Split (Moderates vs Extremists) occurred in 1907; (4) All India Muslim League was founded in Dhaka in 1906.
qe: Who was the Viceroy of India when the Partition of Bengal was announced and implemented in 1905, sparking the Swadeshi Movement?

q:
महात्मा गांधी के दांडी मार्च (1930) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह 12 मार्च 1930 को साबरमती आश्रम से प्रारंभ हुआ और 6 अप्रैल 1930 को दांडी में नमक कानून तोड़ने के साथ संपन्न हुआ।
कथन II: उत्तर-पश्चिम सीमांत प्रांत में सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन का नेतृत्व खान अब्दुल गफ्फार खान ने 'खुदाई खिदमतगार' (लाल कुर्ती) संगठन के माध्यम से किया।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. Gandhi walked 240 miles (385 km) with 78 chosen followers over 24 days to launch Civil Disobedience, while Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan ('Frontier Gandhi') led Khudai Khidmatgars in NWFP (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) In Tamil Nadu, C. Rajagopalachari led the Vedaranyam Salt March; (2) Sarojini Naidu led the Dharasana Salt Works raid; (3) Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed on 5 March 1931; (4) Gandhi attended ONLY the Second Round Table Conference (1931) in London.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Mahatma Gandhi's Dandi March (1930):
Statement I: It started from Sabarmati Ashram on 12 March 1930 and concluded at Dandi on 6 April 1930 with the breaking of the Salt Law.
Statement II: In the North-West Frontier Province, the Civil Disobedience Movement was led by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan through the 'Khudai Khidmatgar' (Red Shirts) organization.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: 11 दिसंबर 1946 को भारत की संविधान सभा का स्थायी अध्यक्ष किसे निर्वाचित किया गया था?
e: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected permanent President of the Constituent Assembly on 11 December 1946 (डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद संविधान सभा के स्थायी अध्यक्ष थे). Exam Boosters: (1) Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha was the temporary Chairman on the first day (9 December 1946); (2) Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was Chairman of the 7-member Drafting Committee; (3) B. N. Rau was the Constitutional Advisor; (4) The Constitution took 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days to frame.
qe: Who was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly of India on 11 December 1946?

q: 1854 के किस ऐतिहासिक शैक्षिक दस्तावेज़ को 'भारत में अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का मैग्ना कार्टा' कहा जाता है?
e: Sir Charles Wood's Despatch of 1854 (during Lord Dalhousie's tenure) is hailed as the 'Magna Carta of English Education in India' (वुड डिस्पैच, 1854 को भारतीय शिक्षा का मैग्ना कार्टा कहा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Recommended establishing Universities in Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras (set up in 1857); (2) Advocated vernacular medium at primary level and English at higher education, plus female education and teacher training; (3) Macaulay's Minute (1835) introduced the 'Downward Filtration Theory'; (4) Hunter Commission (1882) focused on primary and secondary education.
qe: Which historic 1854 educational document is widely known as the 'Magna Carta of English Education in India'?

q: भारतीय संविधान में मौलिक अधिकार किस भाग और किन अनुच्छेदों में निहित हैं?
e: Fundamental Rights (inspired by the US Bill of Rights) are contained in Part III (Articles 12 to 35), often called the 'Magna Carta of India' (मौलिक अधिकार भाग III, अनुच्छेद 12 से 35 में हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Originally 7 Fundamental Rights; Right to Property (Art. 31) was removed by the 44th Amendment (1978) and made a legal right under Article 300A; (2) Part II (Art. 5–11) = Citizenship; (3) Part IV (Art. 36–51) = DPSP (from Ireland); (4) Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency.
qe: Fundamental Rights in the Indian Constitution are enshrined in which Part and Articles?

q: प्री-स्कूल से कक्षा 12 तक की स्कूली शिक्षा के लिए व्यापक केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना 'समग्र शिक्षा अभियान' में पूर्व की किन तीन योजनाओं का विलय किया गया था?
e: Launched in 2018, Samagra Shiksha subsumed Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA), Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA), and Teacher Education (TE) (समग्र शिक्षा में SSA, RMSA और शिक्षक शिक्षा का विलय हुआ). Exam Boosters: (1) RUSA (Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan) focuses on state higher education institutions; (2) NIPUN Bharat Mission (2021) aims at Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) by Grade 3; (3) PM-POSHAN is the revamped Mid-Day Meal Scheme; (4) Samagra Shiksha 2.0 aligns with NEP 2020.
qe: 'Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan', the overarching centrally sponsored scheme for school education from pre-school to Class 12, subsumed which three earlier schemes?

q: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय (Supreme Court) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: It is a Court of Record with power to punish for contempt under Article 129.
Judges of the Supreme Court retire at the age of 65 years.
Its advisory opinion given to the President under Article 143 is strictly binding on the President.
Its original jurisdiction under Article 131 covers Centre-State federal disputes.
e: Advisory opinion rendered by the Supreme Court under Article 143 is purely advisory and NOT legally binding on the President (अनुच्छेद 143 के तहत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की सलाह राष्ट्रपति पर बाध्यकारी नहीं होती). Exam Boosters: (1) Supreme Court of India was inaugurated on 28 January 1950 (First CJI: H. J. Kania); (2) High Court judges retire at age 62 (raised from 60 by 15th Amendment); (3) Article 137 provides for Review of judgments by SC; (4) Article 142 empowers SC to pass decrees necessary for doing 'complete justice'.
qe: Which of the following statements regarding the Supreme Court of India is NOT correct?
oe: It is a Court of Record with power to punish for contempt under Article 129.
Judges of the Supreme Court retire at the age of 65 years.
Its advisory opinion given to the President under Article 143 is strictly binding on the President.
Its original jurisdiction under Article 131 covers Centre-State federal disputes.

q: प्रायद्वीपीय भारत की प्रमुख नदियों का कौन-सा युग्म भ्रंश घाटियों (rift valleys) से होकर पश्चिम की ओर बहता है और ज्वारनदमुख (estuary) बनाते हुए अरब सागर में गिरता है?
e: Narmada (origin: Amarkantak) and Tapi/Tapti (origin: Multai, Satpura) flow westward through rift valleys into the Arabian Sea, forming estuaries instead of deltas (नर्मदा और तापी पश्चिमवाहिनी नदियाँ हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Narmada flows between Vindhya (north) and Satpura (south) ranges; (2) Dhuandhar Falls (Jabalpur) and Sardar Sarovar Dam (Gujarat) are on the Narmada; (3) East-flowing rivers (Godavari, Krishna, Kaveri, Mahanadi) form deltas in the Bay of Bengal; (4) Luni is an inland drainage river disappearing in the Rann of Kutch.
qe: Which pair of major Peninsular Indian rivers flows westward through rift valleys and drains into the Arabian Sea forming estuaries?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत की कुल जनसंख्या का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत भाग शहरी क्षेत्रों में निवास करता था?
e: As per Census 2011, 31.16% of India's population lived in urban areas and 68.84% in rural areas (2011 में भारत की शहरी जनसंख्या 31.16% थी). Exam Boosters: (1) Goa (62.2%) was the most urbanized state in percentage terms, while Maharashtra had the largest absolute urban population; (2) Himachal Pradesh (~10% urban) and Bihar (~11.3% urban) had the lowest urbanization rates; (3) Uttar Pradesh's urban population share in 2011 was 22.27%; (4) Census is conducted every 10 years by the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India (Ministry of Home Affairs).
qe: According to Census 2011, what was the approximate percentage of India's population living in urban areas?

q: भारत के वर्तमान प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण वाले हिमालयी क्षेत्र (सिक्किम–नेपाल सीमा) में स्थित सर्वोच्च पर्वत शिखर कौन-सा है?
e: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m, world's 3rd highest peak, located on the Sikkim–Nepal border) is the highest Himalayan peak in India's administered territory (कंचनजंगा 8,586 मीटर), while K2 / Godwin-Austen (8,611 m, Karakoram, PoK) is India's highest peak overall. Exam Boosters: (1) Nanda Devi (7,816 m, Uttarakhand) is the highest peak located COMPLETELY inside India; (2) Guru Shikhar (1,722 m, Mount Abu) is the highest peak of the Aravalli Range; (3) Dhupgarh (1,350 m) is the highest peak of the Satpura Range; (4) Saddle Peak (732 m) is the highest peak of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
qe: Which is the highest mountain peak located entirely within the undisputed territory administered by India (Himalayan range, Sikkim–Nepal border)?

q: भारत में प्रतिभूति और पूँजी बाजारों (स्टॉक एक्सचेंज, म्यूचुअल फंड) का विनियमन कौन-सा वैधानिक प्राधिकरण करता है?
e: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India, Mumbai) regulates India's capital markets; established in 1988, it received statutory powers via the SEBI Act, 1992 (सेबी पूँजी बाजार का नियामक है). Exam Boosters: (1) IRDAI (Hyderabad) regulates the insurance sector; (2) PFRDA regulates the pension sector (NPS); (3) TRAI regulates telecommunications; (4) Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE, est. 1875) is Asia's oldest stock exchange (benchmark index: SENSEX; NSE index: NIFTY 50).
qe: Which statutory authority regulates the securities and capital markets (stock exchanges, mutual funds) in India?

q: भारत की 'राजकोषीय नीति' (सरकारी कराधान, सार्वजनिक व्यय और केंद्रीय बजट) किस संस्था द्वारा तैयार की जाती है?
o: Securities and Exchange Board of India
Ministry of Finance, Government of India
e: Fiscal Policy (taxation, subsidies, borrowing, and public spending) is formulated by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, whereas Monetary Policy (interest rates, money supply) is managed by the RBI (राजकोषीय नीति वित्त मंत्रालय बनाता है, मौद्रिक नीति RBI). Exam Boosters: (1) Union Budget is referred to as the 'Annual Financial Statement' under Article 112 of the Constitution; (2) Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure − Total Receipts (excluding borrowings); (3) Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit − Interest Payments; (4) FRBM Act (2003) promotes fiscal discipline.
qe: Which institution formulates India's 'Fiscal Policy' (government taxation, public expenditure, and Union Budget)?
oe: Securities and Exchange Board of India
Ministry of Finance, Government of India

q:
नीति आयोग द्वारा प्रकाशित राष्ट्रीय बहुआयामी गरीबी सूचकांक (MPI) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह तीन समान भारांक वाले आयामों — स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा और जीवन स्तर — में अभाव को मापता है।
कथन II: यह परिवारों को गरीब वर्गीकृत करने के लिए केवल मासिक प्रति व्यक्ति उपभोग व्यय (MPCE) आँकड़ों पर निर्भर करता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is incorrect because MPI is a NON-MONETARY measure using 12 indicators (derived from NFHS data) rather than consumption expenditure alone (MPI में स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा व जीवन स्तर के 12 गैर-मौद्रिक संकेतक होते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) India's National MPI uses 12 indicators (10 global Alkire-Foster indicators + 2 India-specific: Maternal Health and Bank Account); (2) Global MPI is jointly published by UNDP and OPHI (Oxford); (3) Tendulkar (2009) and Rangarajan (2014) Committees used MPCE-based poverty lines; (4) Lorenz Curve and Gini Coefficient measure income inequality.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) published by NITI Aayog:
Statement I: It measures deprivation across three equally weighted dimensions: Health, Education, and Standard of Living.
Statement II: It relies exclusively on monthly per capita consumption expenditure (MPCE) data to classify households as poor.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: मानव लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं में ऑक्सीजन का परिवहन करने वाले हीमोग्लोबिन अणु के केंद्र में कौन-सा आवश्यक धातु आयन होता है?
e: Iron (Fe²⁺) is the central metal ion in the heme group of hemoglobin that binds oxygen (हीमोग्लोबिन में लोहा/आयरन होता है); iron deficiency causes Anaemia. Exam Boosters: (1) Magnesium (Mg) is the central atom in Chlorophyll; (2) Cobalt (Co) is present in Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin); (3) Calcium (Ca) and Vitamin K are essential for blood clotting; (4) Lifespan of human RBCs is ~120 days (destroyed in spleen, called 'Graveyard of RBCs').
qe: Which essential metal ion is at the core of the Hemoglobin molecule responsible for transporting oxygen in human red blood cells?

q: बाह्य अंतरिक्ष में रॉकेट का प्रणोदन (propulsion) मुख्य रूप से भौतिकी के किस मूलभूत नियम पर कार्य करता है?
o: Conservation of Linear Momentum (Newton's Third Law)
e: Rocket propulsion operates on the principle of Conservation of Linear Momentum and Newton's Third Law of Motion (action-reaction: exhaust gases expelled backward push the rocket forward, even in vacuum) (रैखिक संवेग संरक्षण एवं न्यूटन के तृतीय नियम पर). Exam Boosters: (1) Newton's First Law defines Inertia; Second Law gives F = ma (rate of change of momentum); (2) Escape velocity from Earth's surface is ~11.2 km/s (independent of rocket mass); (3) Geostationary satellites orbit at ~35,786 km above the equator with a 24-hour period; (4) Hydraulic brakes work on Pascal's Law.
qe: The propulsion of a rocket in outer space works primarily on which fundamental law of physics?
oe: Conservation of Linear Momentum (Newton's Third Law)

q: साइबर सुरक्षा और डिजिटल साक्षरता में 'फ़िशिंग' (Phishing) क्या है?
o: A hardware cooling technique for high-speed supercomputers
A lossless algorithm used to compress digital video files
A fraudulent attempt to steal sensitive data like passwords by masquerading as a trustworthy entity
An automated backup utility built into operating systems
e: Phishing is a social-engineering cyberattack where attackers send deceptive emails, SMS (Smishing), or fake links impersonating banks or officials to steal passwords, OTPs, or financial credentials (विश्वसनीय संस्था का रूप धरकर पासवर्ड/डेटा चुराने का साइबर प्रयास). Exam Boosters: (1) Ransomware encrypts victim's files and demands ransom for decryption; (2) CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team) is India's nodal agency for cybersecurity under MeitY; (3) Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) and strong passwords mitigate phishing risks; (4) Firewall filters incoming and outgoing network traffic based on security rules.
qe: In cybersecurity and digital literacy, what is 'Phishing'?
oe: A hardware cooling technique for high-speed supercomputers
A lossless algorithm used to compress digital video files
A fraudulent attempt to steal sensitive data like passwords by masquerading as a trustworthy entity
An automated backup utility built into operating systems
